# cpanel_dynamic_dns (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel Dynamic DNS domain and its sensitive webcall metadata.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_dynamic_dns" "home" {
  domain = "home.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The complete Dynamic DNS domain.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The Dynamic DNS domain creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `description` (String) The human-readable description of the Dynamic DNS domain.
- `ipv4` (Set of String) The IPv4 addresses currently associated with the Dynamic DNS domain.
- `ipv6` (Set of String) The IPv6 addresses currently associated with the Dynamic DNS domain.
- `last_run_times` (List of Number) The most recent webcall execution times as Unix timestamps.
- `last_update_time` (Number) The most recent address-change time as a Unix timestamp.
- `webcall_id` (String, Sensitive) The secret identifier used by the Dynamic DNS update endpoint.
- `webcall_url` (String, Sensitive) The HTTPS URL that a router or device calls to update the domain addresses.
